Brand palette generator

Source: R/palettes.R
mariner_pal.Rd

Constructs discrete, sequential, ordinal, or diverging color palettes for a theme.

Usage

mariner_pal(
  theme = mariner_themes,
  family = c("discrete", "sequential", "ordinal", "diverging"),
  n = NULL,
  reverse = FALSE
)

Arguments

theme

Theme name. Defaults to the built-in mariner theme.

family

Palette family: "discrete", "sequential", "ordinal", or "diverging".

n

Optional integer number of colors. If NULL (default), returns a palette function function(n).

reverse

Logical; if TRUE, reverses the color vector.

Value

A character vector of hex colors if n is supplied, or a palette function if n is NULL.

Examples

mariner_pal(family = "discrete", n = 4)
#> [1] "#017553" "#c08802" "#aa4499" "#979731"
mariner_pal(family = "diverging", n = 7)
#> [1] "#017553" "#649C83" "#A8C3B6" "#E9ECEA" "#DECAAC" "#CFAA6B" "#C08802"
pal_fn <- mariner_pal(family = "sequential")
pal_fn(5)
#> [1] "#EAF7F1" "#B2C8BD" "#7D9B8C" "#49705E" "#154734"
